reason: The array is falling and the immediate goal is reserve power, so I will switch to the charged battery.
expectation: The emergency supply will take over essential cabin power; I am unsure whether another backup is involved.

alternatives.reason: The heat store could protect the garden, but securing power seems more immediate.

effect: The essential supply is isolated, but the reserve goal has not yet completed.
reaction: That makes the power switch understandable, though I am curious what remains.
reason: The service trench connects the water line, and the tool may let me isolate it as part of securing the station; this is a guess.
expectation: I expect to shut or disconnect the line for the reduced-power period, though the exact result is unclear.

alternatives.reason: I could move stored heat into the nook first, but I want to secure the services.

effect: The pipe is drained and the inlet closed, with pump and thaw checks on essential power; now the troughs need shelter.
reaction: The specific checks clarify the service tool action and make the reserve plan feel concrete.
reason: Put the stored heat in the nook to keep the crops warm there.
expectation: The heat store will supply warmth inside the growing nook.

alternatives.reason: I could move a trough first, but I want the heat source in place.

effect: The nook now has its thermal buffer, so I can move the plants in.
reaction: The result is straightforward and reassuring.
reason: Move the lettuce into the protected nook as the goal asks.
expectation: The lettuce trough will be sheltered in the warmed nook.

alternatives.reason: The potato trough also needs moving; I have no strong preference between them.

effect: The lettuce is sheltered; the potato trough remains.
reason: The remaining trough needs the same shelter, and this is the only gameplay option.
expectation: The potatoes will join the lettuce in the nook, completing the trough goal.

effect: Both troughs are sheltered and the chapter is complete; no further action for the frozen archive was offered.
reaction: I am relieved for the plants but surprised that the archive mentioned in the introduction did not feature in my actions.

mostWorthwhile.text: Draining the water line and keeping pump and thaw checks on essential power made the reserve plan tangible and explained a practical consequence of the power reduction.

leastWorthwhile.text: Moving the two troughs separately was clear but repetitive, with little distinction between the actions.

surprise.text: The chapter completed after sheltering the plants despite the introduction mentioning the frozen archive; I expected some action involving it.

arbitrary.text: The service tool on the insulated trench was a plausible guess, but its exact purpose was unclear until the result explained draining the line.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue to see how the frozen discovery is protected and whether the station recovers, though this chapter's plant moves were quite mechanical.
